description:
Dear Customer,

We’re pleased to confirm that the product you’re interested in is listed at an original price of $199.99. To provide you with the best possible deal, we’re applying a 15 % percentage discount, which will be reflected at checkout, followed by a further $20.50 off as a flat‑rate discount.

These combined savings are applied directly to the original amount, ensuring you receive the full benefit of both discount types. If you have any questions about the pricing or need additional assistance, please let us know.
